The contradiction is cured within a single minimal, gate-passing operation: 14.2 now vests each Deliverable in Customer with Vendor's present assignment, and the residual sentence is conformed so our Deliverable rights are neither revocable nor limited to the Order Form term — with the remaining preferred elements mapped as already met from 13.2, 14.1, 14.3 and 14.4.
